_comment: BSA plugin hooks (US-S4-03). Three hooks enforce pipeline invariants at the Claude Code event layer before any per-skill logic runs. See skills/bsa-orchestrator/references/ for the invariants each hook protects.

PreToolUse._comment: Single-writer canonical enforcement (INV-02) + schema enforcement (F5, Sprint 5 + v1.0.2 C1 fix). Blocks any Write or Edit targeting the BSA protected-path set: (1) main-cycle canonical state — analysis/canonical/**; (2) discovery canonical state — analysis/discovery/canonical/**; (3) main-cycle marker emission zone — analysis/runtime/ready/**; (4) discovery marker emission zone — analysis/discovery/runtime/ready/**. ALL four path classes need coverage: the original Sprint-5 F5 spec only listed (1), which meant marker drift (Pilot-1-class camelCase marker_id / legacy no_new_facts filename) and discovery canonical drift (ad-hoc ClaimType / tier labels) bypassed the write hook entirely. v1.0.2 C1 adds (2)-(4) to close the gap. The hook itself does identity check (BSA_WRITER=bsa-orchestrator) first, then schema validation via governance/schemas/write_validator.py. Hook exit 0 allows, non-zero blocks with the script's stderr surfaced to Claude.

Marker-gate enforcement on /bsa-promote (two-key promotion). Intercepts Bash calls whose command string invokes bsa-promote and verifies required markers exist BEFORE the orchestrator's own precondition check. Belt-and-suspenders with the command-level check in commands/bsa-promote.md.
